env_allowlist.HOME: runner home used only to address the hash-verified .elan/bin/lake launcher

recipes.network_enforcement: Every Lean replay subprocess runs inside bubblewrap with --unshare-net, a read-only host root, and only a fresh temporary output directory writable; the checker invokes no update, build, clone, or fetch.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line UTF-8 summary bound by validation-receipt.json output_evidence.stdout_semantic_sha256

recipes.expected_output_policy: Six exact summary lines must report three provisional narrow passes and three fail-closed root, assurance, or release boundaries.
recipes.scope_boundary: Trust-zero, network-isolated worker replay of the exact statement and two partial proof bodies, plus separately written same-worker no-import reimplementations of those two ingredients. It covers zero frozen obligations and supplies no strong Lp multiplier estimate, exact root proof, release hermeticity, or distinct-runner independence.

status_boundary: A passing recipe self-tests only a truthful blocked validation packet; it cannot promote the proof dependency, close a frozen obligation or the root, or establish M0/E0/E1, AUDIT-Z, THEOREM-Z, release, or master acceptance.
